DIAGNOSIS READY: Immune Thrombocytopenia (ITP)

The clinical evidence indicates a contradiction to the requested diagnosis: despite the presence of petechiae and mucous membrane bleeding, your platelet count is normal (280,000/μL) and your coagulation studies (PT, PTT) are within normal limits. This presentation of bleeding symptoms with normal hemostasis labs rules out thrombocytopenia, von Willebrand disease, and coagulation factor deficiencies. Do you have a history of recent viral infections or autoimmune disorders?
